dashboard.label: TA-ups Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype ups:metrics); series prefixed 'ups.'.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-ups" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

single.option: key beacon within 3h - enter a key on the License page

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-ups. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-ups requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-ups", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-ups/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: All ups.* series (device count + per-device state)

search.query: | mstats avg("ups.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "ups.*"
| mstats avg("ups.*_battery_charge") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "ups.*_battery_charge"
| mstats avg("ups.*_load") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "ups.*_load"
| mstats avg("ups.*voltage") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "ups.*voltage"
| mstats avg("ups.*_on_battery") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "ups.*_on_battery"
